correctness.rationale: For GP(10,3), the complete 2^20-mask census agrees under two independent face predicates, 62049 faces including the empty face. The supplied self-contained verifier constructs 31001 paired covers and verifies the entire 62049-vertex directed Hasse graph acyclic. Its three critical 6-cells and forty-four critical 7-cells give, after the empty/vertex pair is removed, exactly one 0-cell and those high cells. Signed integral boundary cancellation yields a 3x44 Morse differential with an explicit determinant -1 minor from critical 7-face rows 0,3,14. Consequently the 6-skeleton is a wedge of three 6-spheres and all top attaching maps are classified by degrees via Hurewicz; primitive cancellation gives precisely forty-one 7-spheres. No finite-to-infinite inference, and the actual script and exact output are embedded.

value.rationale: This is the complete integral homotopy type of a natural first higher-independence / three-path-free complex of the classical Desargues configuration incidence graph, a 20-vertex symmetric cubic graph outside established tree/chordal classification families. A wedge of forty-one 7-spheres obtained from a complex with cells through dimension eleven is a nontrivial finite structural benchmark; the exact invariant and graph are independently motivated, and the computation distinguishes the higher invariant sharply from the known ordinary independence type. Neither a routine normalization check nor an arbitrary graph slice, and no larger theorem is falsely asserted.
